neighbours.label: ' multiple' (and similar modifiers) inside a medical term for a disease or disorder: multiple sclerosis, multiple organ failure, multiple myeloma
fire: My aunt has lived with multiple sclerosis for twenty years.
Septic shock can quickly lead to multiple organ dysfunction.
He was treated for multiple myeloma at the cancer centre.
The trauma patient suffered multiple fractures and internal bleeding.
Multiple endocrine neoplasia is an inherited tumour syndrome.
Children with multiple disabilities need coordinated care.
The scan showed multiple lesions in the liver.
The drug is approved for relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis.

Children with hearing loss need coordinated care.
The scan showed a small lesion in the liver.
The drug is approved for relapsing forms of psoriasis.
